instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard in React JS with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Utilize dark tactical palette (#090A0F canvas, #12141C panel, #181B26 cards, #06B6D4 tactical cyan, #F59E0B cyber amber, #EF4444 signal crimson).
Font styling: Headings MUST use Barlow Condensed font with tracking-tight and uppercase. Body MUST use Inter. Monospace numbers/code MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Implement all 11 key functionalities as distinct, interactive tab views or integrated panels within the operator console.
Include realistic mock data generators for live YOLO bounding boxes, camera streaming simulation, fact ledger streaming, and GPU telemetry.
Include HTML5 Canvas or SVG drawing logic for the Zone Polygon Editor.
Ensure JSON/CSV download functionality works seamlessly on the Fact Ledger.
Ensure every interactive element has a proper data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use standard default light templates or rounded bubbly designs; maintain a sharp, high-density, professional command-center aesthetic (Palantir/Verkada style).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Maintain natural operator UI flow.
Always use modern button styles like sharp/pill buttons with hover glow animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons or custom SVGs.
Use 2-3x generous spacing in panel padding to maintain breathing room in dense UI.
Subtle scanlines, noise textures, custom status pulses, and selection states separate good from extraordinary.
